# Locked with hashes for linux x86_64, Python 3.11-3.15 (the matrix this repo tests).
# numpy, scipy and contourpy have no single release with wheels for both 3.11 and
# 3.15, so those carry python_version markers.
# Regenerate: pip install --dry-run --report --only-binary=:all: --python-version X
# --platform manylinux_2_28_x86_64 for each of 3.11-3.15, diff the resolved graphs,
# and re-hash from PyPI (linux x86_64 wheels only).
